## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Security and privacy impact

Describe changes to authentication, IPC, navigation, permissions, filesystem or
network access, plugins, packaging, or data handling. Write “none” only after
checking the threat model.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`
- [ ] Relevant live/package smoke tests
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, account data, or proprietary source added
